issues.description: Hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. This is the most severe issue causing potential broken state.
issues.root_cause: Likely a price formatting issue using locale-specific number formatting (e.g., toLocaleString()) or Date/Math.random() in server-rendered content that produces different output on server vs client. Could also be currency symbols rendered differently SSR vs CSR.

issues.description: Missing card descriptions — each budget tier card should have a description text but none is visible on the Essential card shown.
issues.root_cause: Card component likely missing a description field in the budget tiers data array, or the description element is not rendered in the card JSX.

issues.description: Continue button is not visible anywhere on screen. Expected behavior requires a Continue button to proceed after selecting a budget tier.
issues.root_cause: Continue button may be rendered below the card carousel but not visible due to layout/overflow issues, or it's conditionally rendered only after scroll/selection and the condition is not being met.
